result.title: CineMME: From Dialogue Grounding to Narrative Reasoning in Multimodal Video Understanding
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). Project page: https://cinemme.github.io/
result.summary: Narrative video understanding requires more than recognizing visible events: models must extract evidence from dialogue, bind it to speakers, and use it to infer narrative meaning. Existing video benchmarks evaluate aspects of this problem, including video question answering, audio-visual reasoning, and temporal grounding, but rarely test whether these abilities form a coherent dialogue-to-plot evidence chain within the same clips. We introduce \textbf{CineMME}, a human-verified benchmark designed to diagnose dialogue-grounded plot understanding, supported by approximately $1,600$ expert person-hours of annotation. CineMME contains $975$ curated short narrative video clips and two linked tracks: \textit{CineMME-Grounding}, with $13,554$ timestamped speech segments and $33,083$ speaker face boxes for temporal dialogue localization, transcription, and active-speaker grounding; and \textit{CineMME-Reasoning}, with $1,600$ multiple-choice and $316$ open-ended questions spanning perception, audio, narrative, social, and scene-presentation understanding. Our main evaluation compares $20$ MLLMs on reasoning and $9$ omni-modal models on grounding. The results reveal a pronounced who-what-when decoupling: Gemini-3 Pro localizes dialogue in time ($68.34\%$ tIoU) and transcribes it with a WER of $28.99\%$, yet achieves only $7.74\%$ vIoU for active-speaker grounding while achieving $67.66\%$ MCQ accuracy on questions with extractable answers. Modality ablations further show that vision is not uniformly beneficial: it improves performance on perception-heavy questions but can hurt dialogue-centric reasoning. CineMME provides a compact diagnostic testbed for evaluating how multimodal video models connect dialogue, speakers, visual evidence, and narrative meaning.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 CineMME，一个经人工核验的叙事视频理解基准，含时序对话/说话人定位与多选题、开放题推理两个关联赛道，并评测约 20 个 MLLM 与 9 个全模态模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中的「who-what-when 解耦」与模态消融（视觉在对话主导问题上反而有害）可供核查模型是否真正使用视觉证据、是否存在视觉旁路与语言先验替代，但领域偏叙事影视，与 LVR 状态生成机制联系较弱。
